paper.title: Understanding Semantic IDs: From Item Representation to Item Selection in Generative Recommendation

source.reuse_boundary: SIDScope records URLs and hashes and ships an independent MIT interoperability contract. It does not vendor source from the anonymous artifact.

snapshot_consistency.assessment: The paper links the snapshot and the snapshot contains exact ISD evaluators and tests, but the root README describes a broader different review snapshot. Treat method files as official anonymous artifact evidence while retaining the repository-level mismatch.

source_files.evidence: support_maps, native candidate ranking, equal-weight prefix RRF, valid generated-item filtering, and final item RRF
target-free provider context, deterministic shortlist construction, prefix receipts, provider audit fields, and SASRec-ISD rule identity
cached train-only UniSRec provider route and target-history leakage checks
beam width 50, shortlist size 50, RRF constant 60, equal weights, immutable input bindings, and validation-only split boundary
stable score ties, visited-item masking, target-free context sanitization, and shortlist-only support-map tests

method_contract.provider_boundary: rank the eligible catalog once from target-free observed history and keep the top-J items
method_contract.prefix_support_rank: minimum provider rank among shortlist items whose SID begins with the candidate prefix
method_contract.prefix_selection: retain the B highest fused prefixes at each semantic position; collision suffix remains native-scored in the audited evaluator
method_contract.non_insertion_invariant: final ranking may reorder only items resolved from generated complete SIDs

configuration_boundary.checkpoint_boundary: Source expects hash-bound local generator and provider checkpoints; none are distributed by the anonymous source-only snapshot.

risks_and_blocks: The anonymous snapshot does not expose a Git commit, tag, or other immutable repository revision through its public metadata endpoint.
No root code license is present; retain NOASSERTION as a non-redistribution marker rather than an experiment gate.
The root README title and main workflow do not identify ISD even though exact ISD scripts and tests are present.
No checkpoint, semantic-ID cache, processed dataset, trace output, or training log is distributed.
The audited evaluator resolves complete SIDs through a one-item map; SIDScope must preserve collisions explicitly instead of silently overwriting an item.
